Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(compact_tables: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
